original_query: Write a one-paragraph note on a post-it to your coworker congratulating them on their personal achievement. Use a friendly and upbeat tone and include specific details about what they achieved and why it is particularly noteworthy.
initial_query: Need a quick Post-it congrats note for a coworker’s big personal milestone—make it friendly and specific.
prompt_trajectory: Can you help me clean up a Post-it note for a coworker—congrats on a big personal milestone? I need it quick and friendly, but also kind of specific… actually keep it super short, but still make it feel personal. On second thought, don’t assume what the milestone is—unless you can make it work without naming it. Just give me something I can stick on their monitor today.
This is a bit long and generic for a Post-it. Can you give me 3 ultra-short options (1–2 lines max) that feel personal but don’t name the milestone, and avoid “inspire us all”/big corporate vibes?

Closer, but still a bit generic/“milestone” sounds canned. Can you give me 3 options that don’t use the word milestone, and feel more like a real coworker note (1 line each)? Maybe one that’s more playful, one neutral, one warm.
